items.title: Edward "Noon" Johnson Interview, 1960-05-28
items.q: He showed me a few keys, showed me a keyboard.

ctx.x: He showed me a few keys, showed me a keyboard. And you might have heard of this great tuba play, he's dead from over the river. Used to call his song. Let me see, can I call his name?
I think, did Eddie Jackson come with the most? Eddie Jackson.
